newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Bakrieland active on new project talk.
newsitem.headline: Bakrieland active on new project talk.

text.p: Shares of Indonesian property developer PT Bakrieland Development rose 8.97 percent in late afternoon trading on Friday due to strong market talk that it would become involved in infrastructure projects, brokers said.
At 0835 GMT, it was up 175 rupiah to 2,125 rupiah in active trading on turnover of 73.3 million shares.
"I heard the company might become involved in the construction of a mass rapid transportation project," a broker with local firm said.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment.

Market talk, however, has said the unlisted Bakrie Group intended to participate in a consortium to build a mass transit system for Jakarta. Bakrie Group and Bakrieland are headed by separate brothers from the Bakrie family and are not directly linked.

Previously brokers had said sentiment towards Bakrieland had been boosted by talk of possible acquisitions after an executive of its holding company, PT Bakrie Capital Indonesia, told Reuters on Thursday the proceeds of a planned rights issue would be used to finance some acquisitions.
No details of the rights issue were available.
Shares of Bakrieland have risen about 20 percent in active trading since Thursday.
